author: Howard Jansen
text: It’s been a few years since I had a sensor fail before the end of the prescribed time period (went from Libre 3 to the Libre 3+).

author: Hanna Babin Gianelloni
text: We’ve only had 1 sensor not connect after the warmup period and that was due to a bent cannula. Every other sensor has lasted all 15 days.
